description: This file defines interfaces and functions for parsing and handling markdown blocks, including block types, parsing logic, and block management.

classes.name: continuation
classes.description: Represents a continuation of a markdown block with indentation and remaining range.

classes.name: blockBase
classes.description: Base struct implementing default behaviors for Block interface.

classes.name: ContainerBlock
classes.description: Interface extending Block with method to add child blocks.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Represents a range within the markdown text with start and end positions.

methods.name: closeBlocks
methods.description: Closes a list of blocks and collects reference definitions from paragraphs.

methods.name: ParseBlocks
methods.description: Parses markdown text into a Document object and reference definitions, handling block structures.

methods.name: blockStart
methods.description: Determines the start of a new block (quote, list, code, etc.) based on markdown content.

methods.name: blockStartOrParagraph
methods.description: Returns either a new block start or a paragraph, if applicable.
